changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'queue' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Task') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [queue].[Task]( [ID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueTask_ID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [Action] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [Custom] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [Date] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueTask_Date] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [MachineAssigned] [varchar](250) NULL, [HasError] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueTask_HasError] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [ErrorMessage] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [NumberOfRetries] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueTask_NumberOfRetries] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Priority] [smallint] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueTask_Priority] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueTask_AssetID] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_QueueTask] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END ELSE BEGIN ALTER TABLE [queue].[task] ALTER COLUMN [Custom] nvarchar(max) null END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_QueueTask') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_QueueTask] ON [queue].[Task] ( [Date] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_QueueTask_MachineAssignedNumRetries') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_QueueTask_MachineAssignedNumRetries] ON [queue].[Task] ( [MachineAssigned] ASC, [NumberOfRetries] ASC ) INCLUDE([Date],[ID],[Priority]) END
